newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Farmers Bank cuts MLR by 25 bps.
newsitem.headline: Thai Farmers Bank cuts MLR by 25 bps.

text.p: Thai Farmers Bank on Monday said it would cut its minimum lending rate by 25 basis point to 13.00 percent, effective from Tuesday.

The bank also cut the deposit rates for 3-month tenors by 25 basis points to 8.50-9.50 percent and for 6-month and 12-month tenors by 25 basis points to 8.25-9.00 percent. The rates will be effective on Tuesday, a bank official said.
But the bank kept its minimum retail rate unchanged at 13.25 percent, he added.
TFB was the third bank after Krung Thai Bank and Siam Commercial Bank to announce rate cuts on Monday after a signal by the central bank that it is ready to relax its tight monetary policy.
Thai lending rates are among the highest in the region.
